{{Short description|Uniform tiling of the hyperbolic plane}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U54_02}}
In [[geometry]], the '''rhombitetrapentagonal tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,2</sub>{4,5}.

== Dual tiling ==
The dual is called the ''deltoidal tetrapentagonal tiling'' with [[face configuration]] V.4.4.4.5.
:[[File:H2-5-4-deltoidal.svg|240px]]
